title: Discount expiry and usage limits
prompt:
Discount codes need an expiry date and a usage limit.

Add optional `expiresAt?: Date` and `maxUses?: number` to both kinds of `Discount`. `OrderStore.place` throws, and changes nothing (no stock taken, no charge, no use counted), when the discount has expired (it has expired when `now >= expiresAt`) or has already been used `maxUses` times.

A use counts only when an order is placed successfully: a declined charge doesn't use it up. Customers sometimes press the order button twice, so two orders placed at the same moment must never use a code more times than `maxUses` allows.

Add `OrderStore.timesUsed(code: string): number`, matching codes without regard to case, as `DiscountBook` does. A code that has never been used gives 0.
